title: ContactClaim payload
description: One identifier. Attributable subject contacts may be match keys. possible_ocr_identifier lives on claim.flags, not here. Unattributable values are stored and must not be used as match keys (02-F2.1).

normalized.description: email lowercased; phone E.164 if parseable else digits-only; linkedin path lowercased; url hostname+path lowercased.
